svg.title: ISO date with optional time
svg.desc: Railroad diagram of the regular expression (?<year>\d{4})-(?<month>0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(?<day>\d{2})(?:T\d{2}:\d{2})?(?!\d) with 14 terms. It shows structure; it does not match input. Supplied trace from provider gallery-stub for input "ok input": 2 attempts, 1 matched and 1 not matched. The library shows this external evidence and does not compute it.
